detail: an open slate-grey palm held level at waist height, above which the air bends with immense quiet weight as a spoken wish condenses into a smooth, heavy stone tablet inscribed with a single irreversible fact

evidence.quote: Immensely powerful, they are said to have the ability grant wishes.

facts.extent: 30 cm span above an outstretched hand
facts.scale_ref: a palm significantly broader and longer than a human hand, cradling a dense stone token
facts.material: compressed slate, refractive atmospheric distortion, pale mountain mist
facts.state: quiet, non-theatrical manifestation of immense power

note: The Grey Wind are said to grant wishes—not through flamboyant sorcery, but with the quiet, crushing permanence of geological fact, often tied to the fate of the ruins around them.
